name: MonarchForceGraph
title: ForceGraph
wrapsNative: SwiftUI Canvas with symbols, DragGesture and MagnifyGesture, inside MonarchChartFrame; a built-in force layout
summary: A network of linked nodes placed by a small built-in force layout, with groups in data colours, link kinds, drag, pan and zoom.
whenToUse: To show how a few dozen items connect, such as linked notes, service dependencies or people and teams, where the shape of the network matters.
whenNotToUse: For a hierarchy, use a tree or an outline. For exact links of many items, use a List; the table of this graph is the same data as text.
api: MonarchForceGraph.init(_ title: String, nodes: [MonarchForceGraphNode], edges: [MonarchForceGraphEdge], groups: [MonarchForceGraphGroup]? = nil, edgeKinds: [MonarchForceGraphEdgeKind] = [], description: String? = nil, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = .ready, height: CGFloat? = nil, showsLabels: Bool = true, selectedID: String? = nil, summary: String? = nil, emptyMessage: String? = nil, footer: String? = nil, layoutOptions: MonarchForceGraphLayoutOptions = MonarchForceGraphLayoutOptions(), labels: MonarchForceGraphLabels = MonarchForceGraphLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onSelect: (@MainActor (MonarchForceGraphNode) -> Void)? = nil)
MonarchForceGraphNode.init(_ label: String, id: String? = nil, group: String? = nil, description: String? = nil)
MonarchForceGraphEdge.init(_ source: String, _ target: String, kind: String? = nil)
MonarchForceGraphGroup.init(_ key: String, label: String, color: MonarchChartColor? = nil)
MonarchForceGraphEdgeKind.init(_ key: String, label: String, color: MonarchChartColor? = nil, isDashed: Bool = false)
MonarchForceGraphLayoutOptions.init(linkDistance: Double = 90, charge: Double = -260, collide: Double = 40, gravity: Double = 0.04, ticks: Int? = nil)

MonarchForceGraphLabels.init(frame: MonarchChartFrameLabels = MonarchChartFrameLabels(), zoomIn: String? = nil, zoomOut: String? = nil, resetView: String? = nil, node: String? = nil, group: String? = nil, connections: String? = nil, noGroup: String? = nil, edgeLegend: String? = nil, nodeCountOne: String? = nil, nodeCount: String? = nil, linkCountOne: String? = nil, linkCount: String? = nil, groupCountOne: String? = nil, groupCount: String? = nil, connectionCountOne: String? = nil, connectionCount: String? = nil, size: String? = nil, inGroups: String? = nil, mostConnected: String? = nil, describe: String? = nil, detail: String? = nil)

options.name: title
options.description: The name of the chart, shown as the frame's heading.

options.name: nodes
options.description: The nodes. A repeated id keeps the first node.

options.name: edges
options.description: The links, without direction. Links to unknown nodes and to the same node are ignored.

options.name: groups
options.description: The groups in legend order. The distinct group keys of the nodes, labelled by key, when nil.

options.name: edgeKinds
options.description: Kinds of link with a colour and dash, listed in a second legend when used.

options.name: status
options.description: ready, loading, empty or error. A ready chart without nodes shows the empty state.

options.name: height
options.description: The height of the canvas. 420 points when nil.

options.name: showsLabels
options.description: Draws each node's label under it.

options.name: selectedID
options.description: The id of a node drawn with an accent ring, such as the open document.

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated summary that VoiceOver reads for the graph.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the empty state.

options.name: layoutOptions
options.description: Link distance, repulsion, collision, gravity and steps of the layout.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the frame's. Sentences with values are formats with %1$@ placeholders.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error status.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Runs with a node when it is tapped or selected with VoiceOver, for example to open it.

states.name: ready
states.description: Nodes as dots in their group's colour with labels, links as lines in their kind's colour and dash, on the subtle background, with zoom in, zoom out and Reset view.

states.name: inspected node
states.description: After a tap, the node has a default-text ring, its links are thicker and opaque, other nodes and links fade, and its group, links and description are written under the canvas.

states.name: orphan node
states.description: A node without links is a dashed outline on the surface colour.

states.name: moved, panned, zoomed
states.description: Dragging moves a node or pans; pinching or the buttons zoom between 0.35 and 3 times; Reset view undoes all three. Zoom buttons are disabled at the limits.

states.name: table
states.description: View as table lists every node by label with its group and its links.

states.name: empty
states.description: The frame's empty state, also when the chart is ready but has no nodes.

states.name: loading
states.description: The frame's placeholder at the canvas height.

states.name: error
states.description: The frame's error message, with Try again when onRetry is given.

appearance: Nodes use the data colours by group (the sixth group and later, ungrouped and unlinked nodes are neutral) with a surface-coloured outline; links use the kind's colour or neutral at reduced opacity; the canvas is the subtle background and labels are default text, in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ForceGraph shows a tooltip on hover and moves between nodes with the arrow keys, nearest in the pressed direction; on iOS a tap inspects a node and writes its details under the canvas, and VoiceOver moves through the nodes in label order by swiping up and down. Pinch zooms as well as the buttons. The layout is the same algorithm as the web's and gives the same shape, though not identical numbers. The controlled activeId is not offered and the layout is not public. The group legend uses dots, the shape of the nodes, where the web uses squares. Dragging on the canvas does not scroll an enclosing scroll view, like a map. Android uses the same names. Several closures are optional (onRetry, onSelect). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is onRetry.
accessibility: The canvas is one element labelled with the generated summary (nodes, links, groups and the most connected node) or the summary given.
It is adjustable: swiping up and down visits the nodes in label order; its value reads the node's label, group, number of links and the linked nodes with their kinds.
With onSelect it has the button trait and a double tap selects the current node.
It carries an AXChartDescriptor for Audio Graphs: the nodes along the x axis and each node's number of links.
Zoom in, Zoom out and Reset view are labelled buttons with 44-point targets.
View as table is the list alternative: every node with its group and links as text.
Colour is not the only key: groups are named in the legend and in each node's spoken text, and link kinds are dashed as well as coloured.
Node labels scale with Dynamic Type and are truncated at 144 points.
edgeCases: A link to an unknown node or to itself is ignored, and does not count as a connection.
Nodes with a repeated id: the first wins.
A single node or nodes at one place are centred at the largest fit scale.
Graphs over 300 nodes use approximate repulsion and collision and fewer steps; the layout runs on the main thread when the nodes, links or options change.
Moved nodes keep their place until Reset view or until the graph changes; a node that is removed loses its moved place.

MonarchForceGraph(
    "Document links",
    nodes: [
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Team handbook", id: "handbook", group: "ops", description: "Operations"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Onboarding", id: "onboarding", group: "ops"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Travel policy", id: "travel", group: "ops"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Security policy", id: "security", group: "eng"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Incident runbook", id: "incident", group: "eng"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Release process", id: "release", group: "eng"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Writing style", id: "style", group: "brand"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Glossary", id: "glossary", group: "brand"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Old runbook", id: "old-runbook", group: "eng"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Meeting notes", id: "notes"),
    ],
    edges: [
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("handbook", "onboarding", kind: "parent"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("handbook", "travel", kind: "parent"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("handbook", "security", kind: "related"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("security", "incident", kind: "related"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("incident", "release"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("incident", "old-runbook", kind: "supersedes"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("onboarding", "glossary"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("style", "glossary", kind: "related"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("release", "style"),
    ],
    groups: [
        MonarchForceGraphGroup("ops", label: "Operations"),
        MonarchForceGraphGroup("eng", label: "Engineering"),
        MonarchForceGraphGroup("brand", label: "Brand"),
    ],
    edgeKinds: [
        MonarchForceGraphEdgeKind("parent", label: "Parent / child", color: .data1),
        MonarchForceGraphEdgeKind("related", label: "Related", color: .data3, isDashed: true),
        MonarchForceGraphEdgeKind("supersedes", label: "Supersedes", color: .data4),
    ],
    description: "Documents and how they reference each other",
    height: 360
)

examples.code:
MonarchForceGraph(
    "Services",
    nodes: [
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Gateway", group: "edge"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Billing", group: "core"),
        MonarchForceGraphNode("Ledger", group: "core"),
    ],
    edges: [
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("Gateway", "Billing"),
        MonarchForceGraphEdge("Billing", "Ledger", kind: "async"),
    ],
    groups: [
        MonarchForceGraphGroup("edge", label: "Edge"),
        MonarchForceGraphGroup("core", label: "Core"),
    ],
    edgeKinds: [MonarchForceGraphEdgeKind("async", label: "Asynchronous", isDashed: true)],
    height: 240,
    selectedID: selected,
    onSelect: { selected = $0.id }
)
